We need apply rule. Input 4x5. Split vertically into top half rows 0-1 (h=4 -> 2) and bottom half rows 2-3. Width 5. Output dimensions (h+1)=5 rows, (w+1)=6 cols. Top half at top-left, then column of 9s at right. Middle row all 9s. Bottom half at bottom-right with leading column 9s.

Input:
row0 [1,1,1,6,1]
row1 [1,1,1,1,1]
row2 [6,6,6,6,6]
row3 [6,1,6,6,6]

Top rows output:
[1,1,1,6,1,9]
[1,1,1,1,1,9]
Middle row: [9,9,9,9,9,9]
